title: Global hunger decline summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Roser, Ritchie), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data / UN FAO hunger figures (CC-BY): one-in-three (~33%) in developing countries hungry in 1970, falling to 12% by 2015 (a ~21 pp decline, more than halved); nearly one-in-ten globally today; North America/Europe below 2.5%. Clean version verified internally consistent before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
